findings.quote: `listHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit, offset })` from `directory_households` ordered by `sort_key, name`
findings.problem: Presented as an existing 1.7a export, but G4's 1.7a prompt names this query `searchHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit, offset })`; `listHouseholds` appears nowhere in G4. The 5.1a/5.1b/5.2 agents would look for a function that does not exist and likely add a duplicate.
findings.fix: Replace every `listHouseholds` in 5.1a (Inputs, Build 2), 5.1b (Build 7 household picker) and 5.2 (Inputs, Build 2 `useHouseholds`) with `searchHouseholds` and add in 5.1a Inputs: "(1.7a named it `searchHouseholds`; do not add a second `listHouseholds`)".

findings.quote: `getSignedUrl(BUCKETS.directoryPhotos ?? 'directory-photos', photo_path, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS)` … export `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` from `@church/domain/limits.ts` if 1.6a did not
findings.problem: G4's 1.6a `BUCKETS` is keyed by bucket name with `.fileSizeLimitBytes` and `.allowedMimeTypes` per bucket (e.g. `BUCKETS['sermon-media'].fileSizeLimitBytes`) and is asserted byte-for-byte against the `storage.buckets` rows. `BUCKETS.directoryPhotos` is the wrong shape and `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` duplicates `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes`; the `('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')` literal duplicates `.allowedMimeTypes`.
findings.fix: In 5.1a Build 2 use `BUCKETS['directory-photos']` (bucket id `'directory-photos'`); in Build 5 validate with `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].allowedMimeTypes` and `.fileSizeLimitBytes` (10 MiB) and drop the new constant. Propagate: 5.1b Build 5, 5.2 Inputs/Build 12 (`DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` → `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes`), 5.3b unaffected, and remove `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` from the open_issues names list.

findings.quote: map the trigger's direction error key (read the exact key from the catalogue in `9999_init.sql` section (5) / `errors.ts`)
findings.problem: G2's 1.3b fixes the catalogue and tells G3/G4 to reuse it exactly: `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (42501), `not_household_editor` (42501), `field_not_editable` (42501), `minor_cannot_have_account` (P0001), `household_role_not_allowed` (P0001), `duplicate` (23505). Leaving the names open invites divergent mappings and the open_issues entry "G2/G4 should make sure those keys exist" is stale.
findings.fix: 5.1a Build 7: "map `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (42501) to the tooltip sentence; `not_household_editor` → generic 403 text". 5.1a Build 6: "a `duplicate` (23505) DomainError from the partial index". 5.1b Inputs/Build 6: replace "the COPPA / linking keys 1.3b defined (read them)" with `minor_cannot_have_account` (P0001) and `duplicate` (23505); Build 3/1 non-admin keys `field_not_editable`. 5.2 Inputs: "the privacy-direction and COPPA keys" → `privacy_direction_not_allowed`, `minor_cannot_have_account`. Rewrite the open_issues entry to say the keys come from G2's 1.3b catalogue.

findings.problem: G4's 1.6b already ships `saveLeaderNotesSchema` (`kind: 'household' | 'person'`, `id`, `notes` ≤ 4000); a differently named additive schema would duplicate it.
findings.fix: Replace with "parse with 1.6b's `saveLeaderNotesSchema` (notes ≤ 4000)" and delete `leaderNotesSchema` from the open_issues names list.

findings.quote: the `app.guard_household_privacy_columns` trigger enforces founder decision 1 — "household adults any direction (stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`); directory admins only toward more privacy; super admin any; audited"
findings.problem: The quoted text is DESIGN §4.4's RPC-semantics sentence for `set_household_privacy`, not founder decision 1 (which is quoted correctly a few lines later).
findings.fix: Change to: "the `app.guard_household_privacy_columns` trigger enforces the direction rule (DESIGN §4.4: 'household adults any direction (stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`), directory admins only toward more privacy, super admin any; audited'), which founder decision 1 extends to `hide_from_congregation`".

findings.fix: Replace with: "`directory_households.anniversary_display` shows `MM-DD` only and `select * from household_leader_notes` returns 0 rows for that member".

findings.quote: `TODO(5.6): replace with an atomic set_head_of_house RPC in the next migration`
findings.problem: Step 5.6 is join codes (G13); the drafter's own proposal for the atomic RPC is step 5.8. The code comment points agents at the wrong step.
findings.fix: Use `TODO(5.8): replace with the atomic set_head_of_house RPC (proposed follow-up migration)` here, in the HANDOFF Deviations line, and in 5.2 Build 9 ("belongs to the next migration, 5.6's `9998_*`" → "proposed step 5.8").

findings.quote: `audiences.ts` — the pure mirror of `app.person_in_kind` (whatever 1.6a exported: a function taking a person-like record …)
findings.problem: G4's 1.6a fixes the exports: `personInKind(p, kind, ctx)`, `isMinor(p, settings, asOf)`, `isAdult(p, settings, asOf)`, `isYouth(p, …)`, plus `dates.ts` `todayInZone(tz, now)`/`ageOn`. Likewise `marital_status` values are fixed by G2 (`unknown, single, married, widowed, divorced`).
findings.fix: Name them: "`personInKind(p, kind, ctx)`, `isMinor`, `isAdult`, `isYouth` from `@church/domain/audiences.ts`" (also in 5.1a Build 6 and 5.2 Build 3/6) and list the five `marital_status` values instead of "read the values from the migration".

findings.quote: (c) Minor (role child or age < `adult_min_age`, or no birthdate with role `other`)
findings.problem: DESIGN §4.3 says a person with role `other` and no birthdate is neither minor nor adult, and G2's `save_person` refuses `user_id` only when `app.is_minor` is true — so the DB allows linking such a person while this UI treats them as a minor and blocks it.
findings.fix: Split state (c) into `minor` (role child, or birthdate and age < adult_min_age → COPPA text) and `unknown_age` (role `other`, no birthdate → show the amber "add birthdate or role" badge; linking allowed by the DB — either allow it or state explicitly that the UI is stricter than the DB and record that in docs/RLS.md). Adjust `accountLinkState` tests accordingly.

findings.quote: The mobile app holds only `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` — no elevated keys
findings.problem: PLAN §7 / DESIGN §8 give the mobile app three public vars; `EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL` (used for the hosted embed page and deep links) is omitted.
findings.fix: "The mobile app holds only the `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values (`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL`) — no elevated keys".

findings.problem: DESIGN §10 lists a separate `person/*` stack for mobile; PLAN §9 lists only `directory/*`, `household/*`, `events/*`. Orchestrator decision 10 says PLAN wins but the prompt must note the DESIGN wording when it diverges.
findings.fix: Add to Build 5 (or notes): "DESIGN §10 sketches a top-level `person/*` stack; PLAN §9 does not, so person detail lives under `directory/person/[id]` — record this in HANDOFF Deviations".

findings.quote: therefore the UI must offer "Nobody" by pointing at a non-matching choice? It cannot — read `app.user_in_group` and the `ca_events_insert` policy body: if null admits everyone
findings.problem: DESIGN §4.3 states the semantics outright: `app.user_in_group(group_id) = group is null or person_in_group(...)`, and G2's 1.3a `on_org_created` sets non-null submit groups on the four defaults. The prompt hedges and half-suggests a "Nobody" option that cannot exist, which could lead the agent to ship a misleading control.
findings.fix: Replace the passage from ""Who can submit events" select…" to "…known consequences." with: "'Who can submit events' select with the same options; the null option is labelled 'All members' (DESIGN §4.3: `user_in_group(null)` is true, so null admits every member). There is no 'Nobody' value — the only leaders-only lever is Settings → Events → 'Members can submit events'; say so in helper text and in docs/RLS.md known consequences." Keep the open_issues entry and proposed 5.8 as they are.

findings.quote: `insertEvent(orgId, { ...row, status: 'approved', approved_by: ctx.userId, approved_at: now, submitted_by: ctx.userId })`
findings.problem: G7's `OrgContext` is `{org, membershipStatus, personId, householdId, permissions, isSuperAdmin}` — there is no `userId` field.
findings.fix: Say where the id comes from: "`userId` from the server client's `auth.getUser()` (or 2.1's `requireUser()` helper) — `OrgContext` carries no user id", or instruct the agent to extend `OrgContext` additively with `userId` and note it in HANDOFF.

findings.problem: G9's 3.6a defines `listNotificationStatus(db, orgId)` with no `kind` filter; the prompt presents the filter as existing.
findings.fix: "`listNotificationStatus(db, orgId)` (3.6a) — add an optional `{ kind }` filter if it is missing (additive, keep the existing call sites green)".

findings.quote: Leaders with `announcements.create` who submit from the app get `approved` immediately by the trigger — show "Published" instead of "Sent for approval" when the returned row's `status` is `approved`
findings.problem: Build 4 inserts `status: 'pending', push: false`; G2's `app.force_event_pending` only downgrades non-holders and never promotes, so a leader's row stays `pending` and the "Published" branch can never fire. The Constraints line ("never bypass the trigger by sending status 'approved' from a member") conflicts with the only way to get `approved`.
findings.fix: Either drop the "Published" branch (mobile always submits `pending`; leaders approve on the web), or insert `status: 'approved', push: false` for everyone and let the trigger downgrade non-holders exactly as 5.3a's web insert does — and reword the Constraint to "send `status: 'approved'` only as the trigger-downgraded default described in Build 4". Pick one and keep the RLS test list (Build 9) consistent.

findings.quote: the next free descending number after 5.6's `9998_join_codes.sql` — planned `9996_directory_events_fixes.sql` unless a 3.10 round used it

findings.fix: "Use `9996_directory_events_fixes.sql`; `9997` is reserved for step 6.1 even if that file does not exist yet. If 9996 is already taken, take the next lower free number and record it in HANDOFF."
